description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Bestseller' extension module in the OpenCart admin system. It manages database operations related to best-selling products, including install/uninstall routines and report data retrieval.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: A model class that manages bestseller product data within the OpenCart admin extension module.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the database table for storing bestseller product data during module installation.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the bestseller product database table during module uninstallation.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates or inserts the total sales count for a specific product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific product from the bestseller list.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller products ordered by total sales, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller products recorded in the database.
